question.problem: The vector $\mathbf{a}$ has magnitude $7,$ the vector $\mathbf{b}$  has magnitude $3,$ and the angle between the vectors is $120^\circ$ and $\mathbf{n}$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $\mathbf{a} \times \mathbf{b}.$ Find $\mathbf{a} \times \mathbf{b}$ in terms of $\mathbf{n}.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\,a\,|\cdot |\,b\,|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =7\cdot 3\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{120}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =7\cdot 3\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot n \\  & =\frac{21\sqrt{3}}{2}n.\end{aligned}
$$
